description: Deletes sheets of a drawing, and every view on them, by selecting each (SelectByID2 "SHEET") and deleting the selection. A drawing keeps at least one sheet: deleting its last is refused. Checked: each sheet is gone and every other sheet is still there. Not rolled back (a deleted sheet's views cannot be made again as they were): a failed check says what is left. Waits, changing nothing (busy, user_editing), while the user edits a view's sketch or the sheet format (sheet_format: true) or has a command open. After the user exits a view's sketch, SOLIDWORKS keeps that view activated and changes keep waiting until the user lets go of it: ask them to double-click the sheet outside every view.

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

sheets.description: The sheets to delete: each a reference (r1.sheet.…) or a name (Sheet2).
